## Summary

One- or two-sentence summary of the feature.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Is it a missing node capability, a UI gap, a developer-experience issue?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you want to happen. If it touches the agent event stream handling (`NativeChatViewModel.handleTransportEvent`), name the `stream` and `phase`/`kind` values involved.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is the proposed solution better?

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other apps, related issues.
